title: Alignment
description: Per-source and per-service clock offsets onto the reference clock, plus the tolerance for onset comparisons, written by Causync as alignment.json (03 §5.1). Telemetry is never rewritten; consumers add the offsets.

reference.description: Reference clock: traces if present, else metrics (also when neither traces nor metrics exist).

offsets.description: Offsets sorted by (source, service), the source-level entry (service null) first.

tolerance_ns.description: Largest effective step in ns among present metric, log and trace sources; 0 if no stepped source is present.

AlignmentOffset.title: AlignmentOffset
AlignmentOffset.description: Clock offset of one source, or of one (source, service) pair.

source.description: Source whose times this offset corrects (full source vocabulary, events included).

service.description: Service the offset applies to; null for the source-level offset (the key is always present).

offset_ns.description: Offset in ns added to this source's (and service's) times to put them on the reference clock; integer, rounded half-even.

method.description: Estimator: reference (the reference source itself, offset 0), trace_pairs, log_span_join, comovement, or none (no estimate, offset 0).

confidence.description: Confidence of the estimate in [0, 1] (1 for reference, 0 for none).
